title: Discere deck
description: A learning deck under data/decks/. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (subdecks only with species from speciesNames, each species in at most one subdeck, unique sourceIds, superseded decks of a lower format version) are checked by scripts/validate_decks.py.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema, so editors complete and check while writing. The app ignores this field.

formatVersion.description: Format version of the deck; missing means 1. Raised only for a change an older app would read wrongly if it ignored it, never for an optional field it can safely skip. The catalog keeps one index per version: data/decks/index.json for 1, data/decks/v<N>/index.json for N >= 2, each with the decks up to that version. The maximum is the newest version; scripts/sync_index.sh writes an index for every version up to it.

name.description: Name of the deck as the app shows it.

description.description: Short description, shown below the name in the app.

imageUrl.description: Cover image of the deck; empty if there is none.

speciesNames.description: Scientific names of every species in the deck, those in subdecks included. App versions without subdecks import the deck from this alone.

subdecks.description: Optional division, e.g. by difficulty. The user switches each subdeck on or off on its own. Requires formatVersion 2 or higher.

supersedes.description: sourceIds of the decks this one supersedes. The app offers to merge them; learning progress follows the species. Requires formatVersion 2 or higher; a superseded deck has a lower formatVersion, so it stays in the indexes of older versions.

learningMode.description: What the deck asks for after import: species, genus or family. If missing, the app asks for the species. Applies only to the first import; an update does not change the user's setting.

nameType.description: Which name the deck asks for after import: common name or scientific name. If missing, the common name. Like learningMode, applies only to the first import.

reviewMode.description: How the deck asks after import: flip the card and self-rate, or multiple choice. If missing, flip. Like learningMode, applies only to the first import. If the deck has too few distinct names in the chosen mode, the app falls back to flipping card by card.

sourceId.description: Stable identity of the deck. Assigned by scripts/sync_index.sh — do not set by hand.

id.description: Stays the same across updates. The app recognizes the subdeck by it and keeps whether the user switched it off.

name.description: Name in the app; may change.
